Extract reference mother, reaching up right, identical face and outfit, one full body transparent figure.
Keep exact mother reference; standing naturally, three-quarter right, both arms relaxed. Transparent, no props.
Keep exact mother reference; face left, bend gently and extend forearms left to pass an object, empty hands. Transparent, no props.
Keep exact mother reference; seated kneeling peacefully, three-quarter left, hands on lap. Transparent, no props.

composition_policy: Each scene is an authored composition of the consistent room, independent character poses, separately controlled interactive objects and state-triggered layer reactions. No zoom on a flattened character scene is used as a substitute for animation.
